captions.detailed: A single-speed fixie bicycle crankset featuring a central dark grey bottom bracket shell, two silver forged alloy crank arms, a large black chainring with outer teeth, and flat black platform pedals. The crank arms are arranged at a 180-degree offset, rotating together continuously around the central spindle. Each pedal is mounted on a stub axle and can rotate freely via a revolute joint relative to its respective crank arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a single-speed fixie crankset with a central bottom-bracket shell, two 180-degree offset crank arms, a multi-toothed black chainring, and flat black platform pedals with small grip pins. The crank arms and chainring must rotate continuously on a central spindle, while each pedal must rotate on its own revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the bottom-bracket shell as a cylinder. Model the spindle and crank arms using cylinders and extruded profiles with a 180-degree offset. Create the chainring by subtracting small circular cuts from a thin cylindrical disc to form outer teeth, and attach it to the right crank arm. Build the pedals using rectangular boxes with small cylindrical pins for grip, and attach them to the crank arm tips using revolute joints.
